description: Deterministic Expo SDK compatibility baseline for admin-mobile. Generated from node_modules/expo/bundledNativeModules.json; committed and reviewed like source code. Regenerate deliberately with `npm run expo:baseline:generate`.

@expo/log-box.reason: Expo Metro/LogBox runtime helper. Published outside the SDK native-module matrix; pinned to an exact version here.

@supabase/supabase-js.reason: Backend client library. Not an Expo module, not versioned by the Expo SDK.

@types/react.reason: Type declarations for React. Follows the React version pinned by the Expo SDK.

expo.reason: The Expo SDK package itself. Its installed version is the anchor of this baseline (the `expo` field above), so it is not a matrix entry.

semver.reason: Build-time tooling used by scripts/check-expo-compat.mjs. Not shipped to the app bundle.

typescript.reason: Compiler tooling. Not versioned by the Expo SDK.

vitest.reason: Unit-test runner. Not versioned by the Expo SDK.
